title: Catering quote for 40 guests
ask: Liam O'Connor asked Fig & Thyme whether we can bring down the catering quote for his 40 person engagement party. His email is in inbox/customer.txt. Offer him the lighter menu, write the reply and send it.
background: The original quote was the full grazing menu, and the lighter one drops the oysters and the second dessert.
The party is on Saturday 18 April at Wharf Hall, which he has booked himself.
We are not busy that weekend, so I would like the job.

constraints.text: show prices in dollars per head and nothing under $38
set the two menus side by side in a table with the columns Menu and Per head
tell him the deposit is due by 20 March

start.inbox/customer.txt:
From: liam.oconnor@customer.example
Subject: Quote for 18 April

The quote is a bit over what we planned. Is there any way to bring it down for 40 people?

Liam
